description: Explain WHY a festival falls on a given date: the rule applied, its version, the confidence, and the day context behind the decision. Use this whenever the user asks why, disputes a date, or when you need something citable. This is what lets you defend an answer instead of merely asserting it.

festival.description: Festival key such as FESTIVAL_DIWALI. Obtain one from list_festivals.

location_id.description: Stored location id. Defaults to 1 (New Delhi). The ids cover 15 South Asian locations only (list_locations) — for any other place call search_locations and pass its lat/lon and tz instead of forcing a nearby id. Never send it together with lat/lon: an id returns the data of that stored location, not of the coordinates.

name: explain_festival
